title: Toe Tag
object: Anodized aluminium tag, 32 x 63 mm, ball chain, two-sided deep engraving.
wall_label: The autopsy wing issues a tag to every specimen that arrives. One side records cause of death. The other records date of resurrection. In the permanent collection, the second field is never blank.
shop_copy: Six causes of death available. Collect the ones that got you.
